Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin with power-adjustable front bucket seats and convenient heated seating surfaces designed for comfort throughout the year.  Technology integration is straightforward and practical. The AM/FM/SiriusXM HD Display Audio System with harman/kardon® premium speakers delivers quality sound for your daily commute. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps your smartphone seamlessly integrated with the vehicle's systems, while the available navigation system ensures you arrive where you need to go.  Climate control receives particular attention in this model with front dual zone automatic temperature settings and rear window defroster, giving all passengers independent comfort options. The heated steering wheel and heated front seats respond to winter weather demands. Power door mirrors with heated glass and automatic defrosting contribute to year-round functionality.  Safety is addressed comprehensively with dual front impact airbags, electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system including overhead and side-impact protection. The back-up camera provides enhanced visibility when reversing, and the tow hitch adds practical versatility for those who need it.  Efficiency and driving experience work together in this all-wheel-drive electric vehicle. The single-speed automatic transmission responds smoothly while delivering consistent power, and the EPA-estimated efficiency of 110 MPGe city and 87 MPGe highway makes this a practical choice for daily drivers. Power steering, speed-sensing construction, and traction control create a responsive, confidence-inspiring driving experience. The 2.0L turbocharged engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers fuel-efficient performance, with EPA ratings of 22 city and 29 highway miles per gallon. Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin that prioritizes your comfort during every journey. Heated front seats provide warmth during cold months, while the automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature. The power-adjustable seats let you find your ideal driving position effortlessly. Premium audio through the Bose system ensures that whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio or your favorite streaming content via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, sound quality remains consistently excellent.  This vehicle showcases Cadillac's commitment to safety and convenience. The comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and 4-wheel disc brakes work together to help protect you and your passengers. OnStar connected services provide emergency communication and vehicle assistance when you need it. The speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving, and the electronic brake assist helps you maintain control in urgent situations. The Driver Confidence Package delivers rear park assist, rear cross-traffic alert, and lane change alert with side blind zone alert to help you navigate confidently. The backup camera provides a clear view when reversing, while electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain grip and composure on varied road conditions.  Performance and efficiency work hand in hand with the 1.2L EcoTec Turbo engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission. Achieving 28 city and 32 highway MPG, the Trax delivers capable power without sacrificing fuel economy. Front-wheel drive provides reliable traction, while the independent front suspension absorbs road imperfections smoothly.  Inside, the cabin is equipped with thoughtful features that enhance every trip. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained and informed. Speed control, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and a trip computer put essential information literally at your fingertips. Automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin climate while you focus on the road ahead.  ***Here at Benton Nissan of Columbia, our goal is truly exceptional customer service. description: This 2024 Honda Accord LX is a well-maintained sedan that delivers the reliability and practicality you need for today's driving demands.  - 1.5T I4 DOHC 16V Turbocharged VTEC engine with CVT transmission - Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow - Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Automatic temperature control with rear window defroster - Rearview camera for convenient backing and parking - Fully automatic headlights with delay-off function - Electronic Stability Control and traction control - Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering - 160-Watt AM/FM audio system with steering wheel controls - Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags - Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry - 17" alloy wheels - HondaLink Assist emergency communication system  The Accord LX combines fuel efficiency with everyday practicality. With an EPA-estimated 29 MPG in the city and 37 MPG on the highway, this turbocharged four-cylinder engine balances performance with savings at the pump. The continuously variable transmission works seamlessly to provide smooth acceleration regardless of road conditions.  Safety features are comprehensive and driver-focused. Adaptive Cruise Control makes highway driving less fatiguing, while the Lane Keeping Assist System helps maintain position in your lane. The suite of airbags, electronic stability control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to protect occupants and maintain vehicle control during unexpected situations.  The interior reflects Honda's attention to functionality and comfort. Front bucket seats with a center armrest provide a comfortable driving position, while the tilt and telescoping steering wheel allows personalized adjustment. The 160-Watt audio system paired with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto gives you seamless access to your music and navigation apps. Automatic temperature control keeps the cabin comfortable throughout the year.  This black sedan is finished with 17-inch blade silver alloy wheels and body-color bumpers, presenting a clean and professional appearance. description: This 2024 GMC Sierra 2500HD AT4 represents a premium heavy-duty truck built for those who demand capability, comfort, and technology in one complete package.  - Power-Retractable Black Assist Steps with LED lighting - GMC MultiPro Tailgate Step Lights - AT4 Premium Plus Package with power sunroof - Gooseneck/5th Wheel Prep Package - Heavy Duty Front Spring/Camper Package - Bose Premium 7-Speaker Sound System - Wireless Phone Projection and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto - Heated and ventilated front seats with 10-way power adjustment - Heated rear seats - Heated steering wheel - HD Surround Vision with Bed View Camera - Automatic Emergency Braking and Front Pedestrian Braking - Adaptive Cruise Control with Following Distance Indicator - Remote Vehicle Starter System  The Sierra 2500HD AT4 combines work-ready engineering with refined daily comfort. Its 6.6L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers the power and control you need for challenging terrain and heavy loads. The truck sits on 20-inch high gloss black aluminum wheels and features a spray-on bedliner with AT4 branding, establishing its off-road pedigree from first glance.  Inside the spacious cabin, the Premium GMC Infotainment System with SiriusXM and a 15-inch head-up display keeps you connected and informed. Wireless charging, multiple USB ports, and integrated trailering technology make both daily driving and towing intuitive. The perforated leather-appointed front seats provide long-haul comfort, while heated and ventilated functions adapt to any season.  Safety technology is comprehensive throughout this truck. Forward collision alert, rear cross traffic alert, lane departure warning, and trailer side blind zone alert work together to protect you and your cargo. The integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance system simplify towing, while ultrasonic front and rear park assist aid in maneuvering tight spaces.  The truck's off-road capability is matched by its on-road refinement. Electronic stability control, hill descent control, and an off-road suspension prepare you for unpredictable conditions, while power steering and speed-sensing technology deliver responsive handling on any surface. The heavy-duty front spring camper package and gooseneck prep package indicate this truck was built for serious work.  With approximately 45,707 miles, this maintained Sierra 2500HD AT4 remains fresh and ready for years of service. The combination of dealer-installed enhancements and factory premium packages positions this truck as a fully equipped solution for buyers who refuse to compromise on capability or comfort. The split folding rear seat expands your cargo capacity when needed, making this vehicle adaptable to your lifestyle. Climate control keeps you comfortable year-round, while the steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.  Safety is built into every drive. This model includes a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and a rear backup camera that provides visual confirmation when reversing. The brake assist system and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver reliable stopping power.  The exterior presents a clean, modern appearance with body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and power door mirrors with integrated convenience features. This Trax LS wears a striking red finish that enhances its confident stance on the road.
